results.title: Kildare's Neasa Dooley to represent Ireland this week
results.description: From humble beginnings with her club, Athy, to League and All Ireland glory with Kildare LGFA, Neasa Dooley continues to break through the ceiling.

results.title: CISF Come Out Flying on Top at Pencak Silat Event
results.description: CISF bagged 12 golds, four silvers and four bronze medals to finish ahead of Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB), who tallied eight golds, four silvers and three bronzes. Maharashtra were third with two gold, three silver and four bronze medals.

results.title: FIFA hit by furious backlash over plans to sell stake in competitions
results.description: FIFA said in its statement that it "would retain sole control of FFE and exclusive authority over football governance, competitions, match calendar, and all regulatory and sporting decisions".

results.title: YMCA Narayanguda To Conduct 26th Kargil Victory Sports Festival
results.description: The YMCA of Greater Hyderabad's Narayanguda branch will organise the 26th Annual Kargil Victory Sports Festival from August 6 to 8.
